sourceNotes: No seed search; same maintained seed/profile across all forms. One west step selected from existing C screen, before form change and before fumbling.
Every runtime change comes from keys. Observer only reads public game data and pure predicates.
New wished fire trap starts unseen. Gloves create real extrinsic Fumbling and timed HFumbling; this does not independently test a seen-trap dodge.
Keep C predictions separate from baseline diagnosis. Do not replace a failed producer or source predicate with observed baseline output.
No fixed shrink result, exact damage roll, or straw survival assumed before parent C.
Nonpaper survivor state excludes natural regeneration boundaries; predicate checks that independently instead of masking HP differences.
